title: Working on an Extraction Mode for Fantasy RPG
author: Enjoyooooor
selftext:
Ive been working on a new extraction mode that will be playable solo or with co op! Building out the core loop currently and testing the 1st base classes! Id love to get any input as there is not much currently in the fantasy extraction genre but i have a feeling we will be seeing (ALOT) more of this genre. For me the thrill of extractions and being able to take chances for massive wins or losses really makes the genre exciting and was able to pull me back into gaming even after stopping for such a long amount of time. 

What are some things that you would like to see in a extraction game with a fantasy setting?

Extraction Mode:

* **Explore connected regions and enter buildings** to search for gear, supplies, and crafting materials.
* **Take on expedition contracts** that give you specific objectives beyond killing monsters.
* **Build your loadout** with different classes, equipment, and abilities. I’m currently testing the first base classes, including Mage.
* **Fight, dodge, and manage your supplies.** Searching can make noise and attract enemies, so looting isn’t always a free break from combat.
* **Extract with your finds** and bring them back to your homestead stash for future runs.
* **Work toward restoring your homestead**, unlocking useful stations and crafting options.



Links for anyone wanting to check the game out! Any Feedback on current build is greatly appreciated.
